entities.name: Kalinago Territory Preservation and Cultural Revival
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Carib Territory (officially renamed Kalinago Territory in 2015) remains one of the last indigenous reserves in the Caribbean, home to approximately 3,000 Kalinago people. Efforts to preserve their language, traditions, and land rights continue alongside eco-tourism development.
